name: japan-business-intelligence-mcp

tools.name: get_holidays
tools.description: Get all Japanese public holidays (国民の祝日) for a given year. Includes substitute holidays (振替休日) and citizens' holidays (国民の休日). Returns holiday names in both Japanese and English.

year.description: The year to get holidays for (1949-2150)

tools.name: is_holiday
tools.description: Check if a specific date is a Japanese public holiday. Returns the holiday name if it is, or indicates it is not a holiday.

date.description: The date to check in YYYY-MM-DD format

tools.name: is_business_day
tools.description: Check if a specific date is a Japanese business day (営業日). A business day is a weekday (Monday-Friday) that is not a public holiday.

date.description: The date to check in YYYY-MM-DD format

tools.name: next_business_day
tools.description: Get the next Japanese business day after a given date. Skips weekends and public holidays.

date.description: The starting date in YYYY-MM-DD format

tools.name: count_business_days
tools.description: Count the number of Japanese business days between two dates. Start date is inclusive, end date is exclusive. Excludes weekends and public holidays.

tools.name: search_indicators
tools.description: Search Japanese statistical indicators from the Statistics Dashboard (統計ダッシュボード). NO API key required — instant access to ~6,000 indicators covering population, economy, industry, labor, prices, and more. Returns matching indicators with codes for use with get_indicator_data.

keyword.description: Search keyword to filter indicators (e.g. '人口', 'GDP', '物価')

tools.name: get_indicator_data
tools.description: Get data values for a Japanese statistical indicator from the Statistics Dashboard. NO API key required. Use search_indicators first to find the indicator code. Supports filtering by region and time period.

regionCode.description: Region code to filter by (from get_regions results)

tools.name: get_regions
tools.description: Get available Japanese regions (都道府県・市区町村) from the Statistics Dashboard. NO API key required. Returns region codes and names for use with get_indicator_data.

tools.name: search_statistics
tools.description: Search Japanese government statistics (e-Stat) by keyword. Returns a list of statistics tables matching the query. Use the table ID with get_stats_data to retrieve actual data.

keyword.description: Search keyword (Japanese or English) for statistics tables

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (1-100, default 10)

tools.name: get_stats_data
tools.description: Get statistical data from a specific e-Stat table by its ID. Returns the table info, classification metadata, and data values. Use search_statistics first to find table IDs.

statsDataId.description: The statistics table ID (obtained from search_statistics)

limit.description: Maximum number of data rows to return (1-1000, default 100)

tools.name: get_meta_info
tools.description: Get metadata for an e-Stat statistics table. Returns table information and classification definitions (dimensions, categories). Useful for understanding the structure of a dataset before fetching data.

statsDataId.description: The statistics table ID (obtained from search_statistics)
